sql: select "foi"."product_id", COALESCE(SUM(foi.total_price), 0) as revenue, COALESCE(SUM(foi.quantity), 0) as units_sold from "fact_order_items" as "foi" inner join "fact_orders" as "fo" on "fo"."id" = "foi"."order_id" and "fo"."workspace_id" = "foi"."workspace_id" where "foi"."workspace_id" = ? and "fo"."status" = ? and "foi"."order_date" between ? and ? group by "foi"."product_id"

select "foi"."product_id", TO_CHAR(foi.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') as bucket, COALESCE(SUM(foi.quantity), 0) as bucket_units from "fact_order_items" as "foi" inner join "fact_orders" as "fo" on "fo"."id" = "foi"."order_id" and "fo"."workspace_id" = "foi"."workspace_id" where "foi"."workspace_id" = ? and "fo"."status" = ? and "foi"."order_date" between ? and ? group by "foi"."product_id", TO_CHAR(foi.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') order by "bucket" asc

select "product_id", COALESCE(SUM(quantity_available), 0) as current_stock, COALESCE(SUM(inventory_value), 0) as inventory_value from "fact_inventory_daily" where "workspace_id" = ? and "snapshot_date" = ? group by "product_id"

select "p"."id" as "product_id", "p"."name" as "product_name", "p"."sku" as "product_sku", "p"."category_id", "c"."name" as "category_name", "b"."name" as "brand_name", "sup"."id" as "supplier_id", "sup"."name" as "supplier_name" from "dim_products" as "p" inner join "dim_categories" as "c" on "c"."id" = "p"."category_id" and "c"."workspace_id" = "p"."workspace_id" inner join "dim_brands" as "b" on "b"."id" = "p"."brand_id" and "b"."workspace_id" = "p"."workspace_id" left join (select "product_id", MAX(supplier_id) as supplier_id from "fact_supplier_deliveries" where "workspace_id" = ? group by "product_id") as "sup_link" on "sup_link"."product_id" = "p"."id" left join "dim_suppliers" as "sup" on "sup"."id" = "sup_link"."supplier_id" and "sup"."workspace_id" = "p"."workspace_id" where "p"."workspace_id" = ? order by "p"."name" asc
